'''Vine snakes''' were a variety of sometimes venomous serpents found in jungle regions of planets such as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], and [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].

They would lie in wait on branches, or among vines for camouflage, waiting for prey to pass underneath. They then dropped down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] their victims through gradual constriction. Nonetheless, they did possess fangs and would bite when provoked. On Dagobah they were commonly preyed upon by the [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwing]].

Vine snakes made up several breeds. Some were thick with brown scales and black mottling. A smaller breed was thin and black with yellow striped patterns.

==Behind the scenes==
In the films, the smaller breed of vine snake on Dagobah was played by South American King Snakes while the larger sort were played by Pythons and Boa Constrictors.
